articles.title: PM Modi departs for 3-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed on July 6 for a three-nation state visit to Indonesia, Australia, and New Zealand aimed at strengthening India's strategic partnerships and economic cooperation.

articles.title: "His vision continues to illuminate our path": PM Modi pays tribute to Syama Prasad Mookerjee on 125th birth anniversary
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi paid tribute to Bharatiya Jana Sangh founder Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee on his 125th birth anniversary, highlighting his contributions to India's nation-building and development.

articles.title: PM Modi's visit will lift Comprehensive Strategic Partnership to "higher level"; deepen defence & critical minerals cooperation: Top Indonesian diplomat
articles.summary: Indonesian officials stated that Prime Minister Modi's three-day state visit will elevate bilateral ties and deepen cooperation in trade, defence, critical minerals, and digital economy sectors.

articles.title: "Futuristic and limitless partnership": India-Japan sign agreements on economic security, AI, defence, says PM Modi
articles.summary: India and Japan signed agreements on economic security, artificial intelligence, defence, and health sectors under Prime Minister Modi's bilateral engagement with Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi.

articles.title: PM Modi emplanes for New Delhi after concluding high-profile State visit to Seychelles
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi concluded his state visit to Seychelles as Guest of Honour for the nation's 50th independence anniversary, securing a Rs 1,250 crore credit line and economic development package.
